answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 12708 Country: United States of America Title: What is the meaning of 'Hania', can I choose this name for my daughter? Can you please also provide some good girl names. JazakAllah. Question: What is the meaning of 'Hania', can I choose this name for my daughter? Can you please also provide some good girl names. JazakAllah. Answer ID: 12708 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 788/616=L/1430) Haniah ( حانیہ ): a woman who tends to one, who loves one Haniah: ( ھانیہ ): pleased, happy You can keep any of the two names, but still it is better to keep names of Sahabiyat like Ayishah, Hafsah, Mariyah, Juwairiyah etc. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
